description_en: Migrates an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance to a specific zone
kebab_example: aliyun dds migrate-available-zone --db-instance-id dds-bp1ece71ff2f0000 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --region cn-hangzhou
name: MigrateAvailableZone

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

If the instance is deployed in a VPC, you must specify the Vswitch parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

如果实例的网络类型为专有网络，您还需要传入Vswitch参数
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination zone.



The source zone and the destination zone belong to the same region.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query the zone ID
parameters.help_zh:
迁移的目标可用区ID。

迁移的目标可用区和当前实例的可用区处于同一地域。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html接口查询可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch in the destination zone.

If the instance is deployed in a VPC, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
迁移的目标可用区虚拟交换机ID。

当实例的网络类型为专有网络时，需要配置该参数
parameters.name: vswitch

parameters.help_en:
The time when the instance is migrated to the destination zone. Valid values:

Immediately: The instance is immediately migrated to the destination zone.

MaintainTime: The instance is migrated to the destination zone during the maintenance window of the instance.

Default value: Immediately
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区的生效时间，取值：
Immediately：立即生效。
MaintainTime：在实例的可运维时间段内生效。

默认为Immediately
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination secondary zone
parameters.help_zh: 迁移的目标备可用区1的ID
parameters.name: secondary_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination hidden zone
parameters.help_zh: 迁移的目标备可用区2的ID
parameters.name: hidden_zone_id
